scheme_name: National Family Benefit Scheme - Uttar Pradesh
other_conditions: The family must be living below the poverty line
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 56,450 in urban areas or Rs. 46,080 in rural areas
The benefit is provided after the death of the only earning member of the family
The applicant must be the head of the family after the death of the earner
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum compensation of Rs. 30,000 is paid to the family of a deceased lead earner.
